business_summary: SoftMedx Healthcare Limited, an investment holding company, through its subsidiary, Wah Yan Bright Healthcare Limited, engages in the medical and well-being business for distribution of medical and healthcare equipment and products in Hong Kong. The company was formerly known as China Wah Yan Healthcare Limited and changed its name to SoftMedx Healthcare Limited in March 2023. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 SoftMedx Healthcare Limited는 자회사인 Wah Yan Bright Healthcare Limited를 통해 홍콩에서 의료 및 헬스케어 장비와 제품을 유통하는 의료 및 웰빙 사업에 종사하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 이전에 China Wah Yan Healthcare Limited로 알려졌으나 2023년 3월에 SoftMedx Healthcare Limited로 이름을 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 1989년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 완차이에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
